description: How often it happens anyway. How many coins first traded inside a market-cap band in a window, how many of those then reached 2x, 5x, 10x and 20x within 3 h, and the median peak. A crossing is a coin's first trade with a market cap inside the band (a coin that jumps over the band in one trade has none); the peak is the highest market cap, curve or pool, in the 3 h after it; USD is at the SOL price of the trade's hour. $0.005 a call, USDC on Solana over x402.

band.description: market-cap band in USD, e.g. 15k-28k; each edge snaps to the nearest of 5k, 10k, 15k, 20k, 28k, 40k, 60k, 100k, 250k, 1000k, and the answer says the band used

payment.description: the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value for this exact call (USDC on Solana). Leave it out to get the offer: the price, the payee and the network come back as the error content and as _meta['payment-required'].

to.description: window end; a crossing needs its 3 h after, so an end under 3 h before the data's as-of is cut

name: base_rate
